query:
insert into user_keys (
                   user_id, public_key_x25519, public_key_ed25519, encrypted_private_key_blob,
                   private_key_nonce, kdf_salt, kdf_params, auth_verifier
               )
               values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
               on conflict (user_id) do nothing
